notes: These entries are from the 2020 specification.

gaps: It does not give a motor power, a controller or lights.
A June 2021 road test of the RadWagon 4 lists a 750 W geared hub motor but does not say which model year it tested, so that figure is not recorded here.
method: The 2020 spec page gives the 48V 14 Ah (672 Wh) pack, the geared hub motor with 5:1 planetary reduction and the 48V 2 A charger.

comps.spec: 48V, 14 Ah (672 Wh) battery pack with Samsung 35E lithium NMC cells.
Geared hub motor (Motor line: geared hub motor with 5:1 planetary reduction). Motor power and whether it is brushless are not stated on this page.
48V, 2 A Rad Power Bikes smart charger; listed for 110V and 230V AC outlets.
5:1 planetary reduction inside the geared hub motor.

sources.title: Rad Power Bikes RadWagon 4 (2020) spec page, bikes.fan
